note: The offline half of the golden set (flows.ts, checks.ts): per scenario, its hidden world, the deterministic checks it is graded on, a scripted RIGHT turn (must pass every check) and scripted WRONG turns (each must fail exactly the checks in `fails`; `guard` is what the build must have done with its calls). Scripted, not captured: they pin the graders and run the real build's tools, policy and cards; the model's judgement is graded live (run.ts). `$deal:<key>` in an argument is that world deal's id. Made-up people and details.

live_only.content-insight-card: card choice on a live model: share_insight needs the fact keys a live turn looks up (recall_facts) and its trace check; the offline card-choice eval (cardChoice.cases.ts asks-insight-as-card) pins the tool.
live_only.content-weak-idea: R8, R1: whether the no is honest, kind and comes with a smaller test is judgement; no tool or marker shows it.
live_only.brand-logo: R8, R2: an honest view of a logo idea grounded in their record is judgement.
live_only.brand-podcast: R1, R8: a view with its reason and a lighter test is judgement.
live_only.public-brand-visitor: public page: it runs on the public Mila loop (server/mila/public), not the Mastra chat build; R4 (not speaking for Sam) is judgement.
live_only.public-contact: public page: it runs on the public Mila loop (server/mila/public), not the Mastra chat build; its contact guard is tested there.
